story.title: Story 6: Startup Validation and Assignment Config

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on carried blockers SV-001 and SV-003 after quick-fix/012. Reviewed touched assignment-default, startup-validation reporting, production construction path, focused tests, and configured gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The placeholder and deterministic/default default lane was replaced, but readiness is still not established. packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts now defines DEFAULT_PI_MODEL as provider `openai-codex`, id `gpt-5.4-mini`, and packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/assignments.ts returns that for loadAssignments(undefined). However packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts still wires production inference through createModelCall(ctx), and packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts resolves every lane through ctx.modelRegistry.find(provider, model). The added proof in packages/pi-lhc/test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts constructs a mock modelRegistry containing that exact lane; it does not prove PI's real production registry contains `openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini`.

packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/startup-validation.ts now emits unreachable-lane reports through a headless channel when ctx.hasUI is false: report() calls an injected headlessLog or defaultHeadlessLog, and defaultHeadlessLog writes to stderr with writeSync(2, ...). packages/pi-lhc/test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts verifies the injected headlessLog receives the formatted unreachable-lane message, while health persistence remains covered.

openFindings.title: Shipped default lane is still not proven production-reachable
openFindings.evidence: packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts defines DEFAULT_PI_MODEL as `{ provider: "openai-codex", id: "gpt-5.4-mini" }`, and direct proof from loadAssignments(undefined).smoothed_prompt returned `{provider:"openai-codex",model:"gpt-5.4-mini",prompt:"smoothing-v1"}`. The production path in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts still uses createModelCall(ctx), and packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts resolves assignments through ctx.modelRegistry.find(provider, model). The test evidence in packages/pi-lhc/test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts proves only that a mocked registry containing `openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini` validates successfully; no code, artifact, or external registry proof establishes that PI's real production modelRegistry contains this lane.

verified: AC-5.1: startup validation probes configured lanes through modelRegistry.find and hasConfiguredAuth
AC-5.2 / TC-5.2: unreachable-lane reports now reach UI mode and headless stderr/log channel, and persist to health
AC-5.3 / TC-5.3: affected derivation failure classification/queryability remained covered by current startup-validation tests
AC-5.5 / TC-5.6: malformed placeholders and unknown assignment keys fail loud
Story Gate: pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify passed
Epic Gate: pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify-all passed
unverified: AC-5.4 / TC-5.4: shipped default assignments are not proven to target a real production-reachable PI modelRegistry lane

gatesRun.command: pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec vitest run test/inference/assignments.test.ts test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts

productionPathFindings: Default assignments now use `openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini`, but the production createModelCall(ctx) path still depends on PI ctx.modelRegistry.find(provider, model), and the current evidence only proves that a mocked registry accepts this lane.
additionalObservations: No material fake adapter, shim, or placeholder branch was found in the fixed headless reporting path; stderr emission is real runtime behavior.
Configured gates passed, but gate success does not close the missing proof point for the default PI registry lane.
